user.title: Sign in to Blossom Energy
user.description: Sign in with your Blossom email and password. The password is used only for this login; only a refresh token is stored locally. Google/Apple login, MFA and CAPTCHA are not supported by this experimental web-login method.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Blossom again
reauth_confirm.description: Use the same Blossom account. Your existing installation and card selection will be retained.

scope.title: Choose your home charging installation
scope.description: Choose the Blossom account and home installation you want to use.

card.title: Choose your Blossom card
card.description: Choose the card that Home Assistant will use to start a home charging session. Recent-session history can also contain sessions from other cards.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed or requires additional verification. Check your credentials and sign in to the Blossom website if needed. No automated MFA/CAPTCHA bypass is attempted.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Blossom. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Blossom is limiting requests. Wait several minutes before trying again.
error.scope_denied: The selected account/installation is not accessible. Check your selections.
error.unsupported_response: Blossom returned an unsupported response. Do not share tokens or raw account data; report the step where this occurred.
error.storage_failed: Home Assistant could not store the token. Check storage and try again.
error.no_cards: No available charging cards were returned for this selection.

abort.already_configured: This Blossom account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally configured for this entry.
